kaps_punt: Berge, bergreekse, valleie en heuwels, riviere, watervalle, kuslyne - kape en baaie (hier net valleie, watervalle en kuslyne); Ligging van geselekteerde fisiese verskynsels in Suid-Afrika - soos St. Lucia-meer, Augrabiese Waterval, Kaappunt, Algoabaai (kaart)

items.bewering: 'n Vallei is laer land tussen heuwels of berge waar dikwels 'n rivier deurvloei.
items.bron: Britannica Dictionary 'valley' (an area of low land between hills or mountains); Britannica 'valley' (geology): valleys are most commonly drained by rivers. 'Dikwels' is die regte kwantor.

items.bewering: Die Breederiviervallei in die Wes-Kaap lê langs die Breederivier tussen hoë berge.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Breede River Valley': Western Cape, Tulbagh to McGregor and Rawsonville to Bonnievale, bounded by the Hex River Mountains and Skurweberge, Langeberg, Boland Mountains and Riviersonderend Mountains; the Breede River flows through the broad valley.

items.bewering: Boere verbou baie druiwe en ander vrugte in hierdie vallei.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Breede River Valley' ('the largest fruit and wine producing valley in the Western Cape', with intensive viticulture); Falstaff and Jancis Robinson on the Breede River Valley wine region (Worcester, Robertson, Breedekloof).

items.bewering: 'n Waterval is 'n plek waar 'n rivier oor 'n steil rotsrand na onder val.
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Waterfall' (a steep descent of a river or other body of water over a rocky ledge).

items.bewering: Die Augrabieswaterval lê op die Oranjerivier (Gariep) in die Noord-Kaap.
items.bron: SANParks, Augrabies Falls National Park (Orange River, Northern Cape); Britannica 'Orange River' (Gariep is the river's other name).

items.bewering: Daar stort die rivier oor harde rotse in 'n diep kloof af.
items.bron: SANParks (18 km granite gorge); Wikipedia 'Augrabies Falls' (gorge about 240 m deep, eroded into granitic basement); Tooth & McCarthy, Geomorphology 2004, via Aberystwyth University research portal (the Orange above the falls flows over Precambrian granites and gneisses).

items.bewering: Die kuslyn is die lyn waar die land en die see mekaar ontmoet.
items.blok: Waar die land in die see uitsteek
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Coast': the boundary where land meets water is called the coastline.

items.bewering: 'n Kaap is 'n punt land wat in die see uitsteek.
items.blok: Waar die land in die see uitsteek
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Cape' (a landform that extends into a river, lake or ocean; example: Cape of Good Hope). The lesson narrows it to the sea, which is true for every cape it names.

items.bewering: Kaappunt in die Wes-Kaap is so 'n kaap en lê suid van Kaapstad.
items.blok: Waar die land in die see uitsteek
items.bron: SA History Online, 'Cape Point and the Lighthouse, at the Southern Point of the Cape Peninsula'; Wikipedia 'Cape Point' (in the Cape of Good Hope section of Table Mountain National Park, at the southern tip of the Cape Peninsula). The lesson does not make the common false claim that it is Africa's southernmost point (that is Cape Agulhas).

items.bewering: By 'n baai is dit andersom, want daar kom die see in 'n wye boog die land in.
items.blok: Waar die see die land inkom
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Bay' (a body of water partly enclosed by land, with a wide mouth); Wikipedia 'Bay' (a recessed coastal body of water). The contrast with a cape ('andersom') holds as a picture: land juts into the sea at a cape, and the sea reaches into the land at a bay.

items.bewering: Die stad Gqeberha lê aan die kus van Algoabaai, 'n baai in die Oos-Kaap.
items.blok: Waar die see die land inkom
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Gqeberha' (the former Port Elizabeth, renamed in 2021, on the western part of Algoa Bay); Wikipedia 'Algoa Bay' (a bay in the Eastern Cape); Addo Elephant National Park Marine Protected Area in Algoa Bay, managed by SANParks.

items.bewering: 'n Meer is 'n groot hoeveelheid water wat deur land omring word en meestal vanself gevorm het.
items.bron: Glossary of geography terms (Wikipedia): a lake is a naturally occurring, fairly large body of water in a basin surrounded by dry land. 'Meestal' correctly leaves room for man-made lakes such as dams.

items.bewering: Die St. Lucia-meer in KwaZulu-Natal is 'n meer naby die see.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Lake St. Lucia': an estuarine lake system in northern KwaZulu-Natal, the largest estuarine lake in Africa, separated from the Indian Ocean by the coastal dunes of the Eastern Shores and linked to the sea only by the Narrows channel and the estuary mouth. It is therefore surrounded by land apart from that channel and fits the lesson's definition of a lake.

items.bewering: Dit is deel van die iSimangaliso-vleilandpark, 'n wêrelderfenisterrein.
items.bron: UNESCO World Heritage List, site 914 'iSimangaliso Wetland Park' (inscribed 1999; the lake is one of its components); IUCN World Heritage Outlook 'iSimangaliso Wetland Park'; isimangaliso.com.

items.bewering: Die kaap, die baai en die meer lê almal aan die kus.
items.blok: Aan die kus en in die binneland
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Cape Point' (tip of the peninsula); Wikipedia 'Algoa Bay'; iSimangaliso Wetland Park (lake along a 220 km stretch of coast, behind the coastal dunes). 'Aan die kus' for St Lucia agrees with 'naby die see' in the previous block.

items.bewering: Die Augrabieswaterval en die Breederiviervallei lê verder van die see af in die binneland.
items.blok: Aan die kus en in die binneland
items.bron: Augrabies: SANParks (near Kakamas, far inland on the Orange River). Breede River Valley: Wikipedia 'Breede River Valley' attributes its hot summers to 'its inland location' behind mountains that block sea breezes. The Breede River itself does reach the sea at Witsand (Western Cape Government, Breede estuary management plan 2024), but the named valley (Tulbagh to Bonnievale) lies inland, so the claim holds as written.

items.bewering: Kaart: Breederiviervallei (Wes-Kaap), Augrabieswaterval op die Oranjerivier (Noord-Kaap), Kaappunt suid van Kaapstad (Wes-Kaap), Algoabaai met Gqeberha (Oos-Kaap) en die St. Lucia-meer (KwaZulu-Natal); Kaappunt, Algoabaai en die St. Lucia-meer aan die kus, Augrabies en die Breederiviervallei in die binneland.
items.blok: kaart (vir: Aan die kus en in die binneland)
items.bron: The same sources as the matching study-block claims above; every place is put in the right province and the coast/inland split matches.

items.bewering: vallei: Laer land tussen heuwels of berge, dikwels met 'n rivier daardeur.
items.bron: Britannica Dictionary 'valley'; Britannica 'valley' (geology).

items.bewering: waterval: 'n Plek waar 'n rivier oor 'n steil rotsrand na onder val.
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Waterfall'.

items.bewering: kuslyn: Die lyn waar die land en die see mekaar ontmoet.
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Coast'.

items.bewering: kaap: 'n Punt land wat in die see uitsteek.
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Cape'.

items.bewering: baai: 'n Plek waar die see in 'n boog die land inkom.
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Bay'; Wikipedia 'Bay'. The entry is also true when read on its own.

items.bewering: meer: 'n Groot hoeveelheid water wat deur land omring word en meestal vanself gevorm het.
items.bron: Glossary of geography terms (Wikipedia), 'lake'.

items.bewering: wêrelderfenisterrein: 'n Plek wat UNESCO erken omdat dit vir die hele mensdom waardevol is.
items.bron: UNESCO World Heritage Convention, 1972, and the Operational Guidelines' 'Outstanding Universal Value': significance so exceptional that it transcends national boundaries and is of common importance for present and future generations of all humanity (quoted by InforMEA, 'world heritage site').

opsomming: All 24 claims are confirmed and the lesson contains no superlative; the one point worth a person's notice is that the Breede River itself reaches the sea at Witsand, but the named Breede River Valley (Tulbagh to Bonnievale) is inland, so 'in die binneland' holds as written.
